# Parts

Every shipped part, grouped by the question it answers; open `node_modules/basalt-ui/docs/<kebab-name>.md` before writing its props.

## Start a page from a block

- `basalt-ui add assistant`: An assistant thread: user bubbles, answers with a folded reasoning trace and actions, and a composer with mentions, attachments and a model picker.
- `basalt-ui add create-flow`: A new purchase order: a three-step wizard dialog with a live preview, a review and a draft kept on reload.
- `basalt-ui add list-page`: The parts list page: saved views with counts, a stock summary strip and a parts grid with bulk actions.
- `basalt-ui add mailbox`: A mailbox: folders as counted tabs, a list of mail under day groups beside a reader the user can widen, a thread, and a composer that opens under the thread, as a panel, a window or the page.
- `basalt-ui add notes-list`: The notes list: type-icon titles, quiet previews, linked records and a detail panel with previous and next.
- `basalt-ui add record-page`: A supplier record: identity band, tabs with counts, editable properties, related tables and an activity feed.
- `basalt-ui add settings-page`: Inventory settings: an inner nav of panes, each a column of bordered sections with forms and a danger zone.

## Wire the app root: the provider and its defaults

- `IntlScope` (`basalt-ui`): one region (a preview, a print view, a fixed-locale page) must format differently from the app

## Frame the app: header, rail and navigation

- `AppShell` (`basalt-ui/shell`): an app has more than one destination and wants one rail, header and tab bar from a single `defineNav`
- `CommandPalette` (`basalt-ui/shell`): the app has commands, shortcuts or a destination list worth reaching from the keyboard

## Lay out a page, a panel or a record view

- `ArticleLayout` (`basalt-ui/page`): a docs or note page needs a title header, a table of contents and prev/next links around its body
- `Callout` (`basalt-ui/page`): an article or reply carries a note, tip, warning or error beside its prose
- `CardGrid` (`basalt-ui/page`): cards of one kind sit side by side and the column count should follow the space they get
- `ConnectionIndicator` (`basalt-ui/page`): a live surface shows whether its data is streaming, polling or cut off, in the end slot of the page bar
- `Dock` (`basalt-ui/page`): a record chosen from a list should stay open beside the screen while the reader keeps working in it, on any page
- `EmptyState` (`basalt-ui/page`): a settled query or a filter left a page or region with nothing to list
- `Facts` (`basalt-ui/page`): the properties of one record are listed as label and value, such as the body of an inspector in a `PageAside`
- `FavoriteToggle` (`basalt-ui/page`): a record's page or panel should offer to pin it to the rail
- `InnerNav` (`basalt-ui/page`): a page has named sections or panes the URL should remember (settings, the sections of a record)
- `OverlayHost` (`basalt-ui/page`): an app opens overlays by key through `defineOverlays`
- `Page` (`basalt-ui/page`): a route renders a screen: its bar, its sections and an optional aside live under one Page
- `PageAside` (`basalt-ui/page`): a screen inspects or edits one record beside its list, or shows the detail of a record without leaving the page
- `PageBar` (`basalt-ui/page`): a screen needs a title, tabs, search, filters, a layout toggle, a refresh button or page-level actions in one band
- `PageSummary` (`basalt-ui/page`): a page opens with a headline that carries its live number and a line of supporting facts
- `Peek` (`basalt-ui/page`): a plain click on a record link or a table row should show the record beside a list or a graph without leaving it (master-detail with the list kept live)
- `PropertyList` (`basalt-ui/page`): a record's own properties are listed as label and value and the reader changes them where they are read: a supplier's contact, lead time and terms
- `Prose` (`basalt-ui/page`): long-form or chat text is rendered as HTML or Markdown and needs the article typography
- `QueryState` (`basalt-ui/page`): a page or region renders the result of one query and must tell loading, failure, offline and empty apart
- `RefreshButton` (`basalt-ui/page`): a page or the shell header offers a refresh of live data, with how old it is
- `Section` (`basalt-ui/page`): a page has several parts that each need a heading, their own controls or an anchor
- `SettingsLayout` (`basalt-ui/page`): a page is settings: sections of rows under one title, with rows a link can point at
- `SplitPage` (`basalt-ui/page`): a page is a list of things plus the pane for the chosen one (settings sections, a record browser)
- `ToastHost` (`basalt-ui/page`): the app calls `notify`
- `Toc` (`basalt-ui/page`): a long page with h2 and h3 headings needs an on-this-page list that follows the scroll

## Show a figure, a record or a list as a card

- `BarList` (`basalt-ui/cards`): a card ranks a handful of named things by one number, or splits a total into its parts (a top-N list, a breakdown that replaces a donut), or ranks long names by a total stacked by kind (horizontal stacked bars)
- `Board` (`basalt-ui/cards`): work items move between states and the user moves them: a pipeline, an issue flow
- `ChainView` (`basalt-ui/cards`): records wait on other records (Issues, tasks, deploy steps) and the answer is what blocks what, beside the table of the same records
- `DataPanel` (`basalt-ui/cards`): a page needs the card frame around a table, a row list or a board, with a header, controls and a legend
- `Delta` (`basalt-ui/cards`): a figure carries its change against a period, passed as `delta` on a stat card or a chart figure
- `Empty` (`basalt-ui/cards`): a frame's query settled with no rows and the card must say why and what to do next
- `EventList` (`basalt-ui/cards`): a card lists activity, history or an audit trail in the order it happened
- `Fact` (`basalt-ui/cards`): a card footer states a fact beside its figure: a source, a time, an id
- `FlowCanvas` (`basalt-ui/cards`): a workflow or a pipeline is a few stages of configured steps with connectors between them (a builder), edited in place, with a workflow-level panel
- `FlowChecklist` (`basalt-ui/cards`): a `FlowCanvas` carries issues and its `PageAside` lists what to fix before the flow runs
- `FootFacts` (`basalt-ui/cards`): a card's `footer` prop takes one or two facts
- `KanbanCard` (`basalt-ui/cards`): a board column lists work items that move between states
- `MailList` (`basalt-ui/cards`): a list of conversations or notifications read newest first, opened into a reader beside it (a mailbox, an inbox, a support queue)
- `MailThread` (`basalt-ui/cards`): a reader shows one mail conversation, or any thread of long messages where one is read at a time
- `RelationshipCard` (`basalt-ui/cards`): a record page lists the records it is linked to (suppliers, signers, people who know this one) and each needs a face, how it relates and a few figures
- `RowList` (`basalt-ui/cards`): the rows are things of one kind, each with a name, an optional second line, a verdict and a figure, shown beside a chart that draws the same items (ids with ages, windows with hours, resources with a hop)
- `Schedule` (`basalt-ui/cards`): dated events with a start and an end are read by the day and the hour: deliveries, calls, shifts, bookings
- `StatCard` (`basalt-ui/cards`): a page shows one headline figure with its change, verdict and trend as a card
- `StatCell` (`basalt-ui/cards`): a status bar or KPI row shows one figure with its subtitle, meter, trend and a few rows
- `StatGroup` (`basalt-ui/cards`): a page shows several headline figures side by side, a status bar or a row of KPIs
- `StepRail` (`basalt-ui/cards`): a pipeline, deploy, job run or trace summary shows its steps and their durations
- `Verdict` (`basalt-ui/cards`): a card states a state in one word with a tone (`status` on a stat card)

## Show many records with columns

- `BulkBar` (`basalt-ui/table`): a bespoke layout places a table's bulk bar itself, or a list that is not a table (a mailbox, a card grid) acts on a selection
- `DataTable` (`basalt-ui/table`): a page lists records that sort, filter, page, select or open in a detail
- `DataTableBody` (`basalt-ui/table`): a bespoke layout draws the table body itself, inside the `DataTable` scroller
- `TablePager` (`basalt-ui/table`): a bespoke layout draws the pager apart from the `DataTable` scroller
- `TableToolbar` (`basalt-ui/table`): a data table needs search, filters or saved views above it

## Draw a value over time, a comparison or a distribution

- `BandStrip` (`basalt-ui/charts`): a single row of states over time is the figure (up, degraded, down; running, failed, idle)
- `Bars` (`basalt-ui/charts`): values are counts or amounts per category or per period, or parts of a whole stack
- `CartesianChart` (`basalt-ui/charts`): a metric needs a time or category chart, or a mix of lines, bars and dots
- `ChartCard` (`basalt-ui/charts`): a metric needs a chart with a title, a headline figure, controls or a footer around it
- `Heatmap` (`basalt-ui/charts`): two ordered categories cross (weekday by hour, service by day) and the cell value is the answer
- `IntervalTrack` (`basalt-ui/charts`): spans with a start and an end sit on rows over time: a calendar week by the hour, the steps of a run, outages by day, shifts by person
- `Lines` (`basalt-ui/charts`): a metric over time or an ordered axis reads as one or more lines
- `Sparkline` (`basalt-ui/charts`): a card, a table row or a strip shows the trend of one metric in a small box

## Let the reader filter, pick or step through

- `AppearanceSwitcher` (`basalt-ui/controls`): a settings page or a header popover lets the reader pick theme, accent, density or layout
- `ControlHome` (`basalt-ui/controls`): you place controls in a surface that is not a slot of a composite (an aside, a sheet, a toolbar)
- `ControlView` (`basalt-ui/controls`): a home draws one `FilterSpec` and must show when a card overrides its global
- `FilterSet` (`basalt-ui/controls`): a page has two or more filters for the same data and they must fit a phone without scrolling or wrapping
- `FormActionRow` (`basalt-ui/controls`): a settings row runs a command (export, revoke, reset) and holds no value
- `FormConfirmRow` (`basalt-ui/controls`): an action deletes or transfers something that cannot be restored (a workspace, an account)
- `FormField` (`basalt-ui/controls`): a form control needs a label, a description or an error
- `FormFooter` (`basalt-ui/controls`): a submit form needs Cancel and Save
- `FormGroupRow` (`basalt-ui/controls`): one setting fans out into several switches or fields (a notification category and its channels)
- `FormRow` (`basalt-ui/controls`): two or three related fields share a line, or a field array repeats a row
- `FormSection` (`basalt-ui/controls`): a settings or edit page groups more than a few fields under names a reader scans
- `Stepper` (`basalt-ui/controls`): a form is split into three or more steps taken in order
- `ViewTabs` (`basalt-ui/controls`): a page or section has a few views of the same data and the visitor must be able to link to one
- `WizardDialog` (`basalt-ui/controls`): a record is created in three or more steps and the user should see it take shape (a contract, a workspace, an invoice)

## Move the reader between pages and links

- `BasaltProvider` (`basalt-ui/router`): an app mounts its tree once at the entry, so the color scheme, the locale, the link every link prop renders through and the push binding are set in one place

## Render prose, markdown or code

- `CodeBlock` (`basalt-ui/content`): a fenced or standalone block of source or terminal output is shown, highlighted, with a copy button

## Show a conversation with a model

- `Composer` (`basalt-ui/ai`): a person writes a message that is sent: a chat prompt, a reply, a mail body
- `Message` (`basalt-ui/ai`): one turn of a chat thread, the person's or the assistant's
- `MessageActions` (`basalt-ui/ai`): the copy, regenerate, feedback and edit buttons of a message the app draws itself
- `ModelPicker` (`basalt-ui/ai`): a person picks the model, or several to compare, that answers a prompt; it sits in the Composer's footer through `model`
- `ReasoningTrace` (`basalt-ui/ai`): the reasoning and tool calls behind a model reply, from another runtime than partView reads

## Check the shipped surface in a test

- `SLOTS` (`basalt-ui/testing`): a test or a browser-lane assertion selects a part, or checks that a module renders the parts it declares

## Use a primitive control or element

- `basalt-ui/ui/accordion` (`Accordion`): several sections belong together and the reader opens the ones they need
- `basalt-ui/ui/alert` (`Alert`): the page must say something about its own state next to the content it concerns: a failed sync, a warning
- `basalt-ui/ui/avatar` (`Avatar`): a person or a company needs a face in a table cell, a record header, a row or a card: round for a person, a rounded square for an object
- `basalt-ui/ui/badge` (`CountBadge`, `DeltaBadge`, `Lozenge`): a state, a count or a change needs a small chip beside a label: `Lozenge` for a word, `CountBadge` for a number, `DeltaBadge` for a change against a period
- `basalt-ui/ui/button` (`Button`, `Pressable`): an action the user takes: save, delete, open
- `basalt-ui/ui/calendar` (`Calendar`): a month is shown inline: a mini month beside a schedule, or a page's day picker with no field
- `basalt-ui/ui/card` (`Card`, `IconTile`, `Inset`): a group of content needs a surface of its own in a hand-built layout
- `basalt-ui/ui/checkbox` (`Checkbox`): a yes or no the user sets, or several independent choices in a `CheckboxGroup`
- `basalt-ui/ui/checkbox-matrix` (`CheckboxMatrix`): a permission or notification grid, where rows and columns are known and each cell is a yes or no
- `basalt-ui/ui/choice-card` (`ChoiceCard`): a choice carries a description, a price or a picture and the options sit side by side
- `basalt-ui/ui/collapsible` (`Collapsible`): one region hides and shows behind a trigger (advanced options)
- `basalt-ui/ui/combobox` (`Autocomplete`, `Combobox`): search, async or multi-select, or 50 or more options
- `basalt-ui/ui/context-menu` (`ContextMenu`): a row, card or item already has a '...' menu and a right click should open the same actions
- `basalt-ui/ui/control-group` (`ButtonGroup`, `ControlGroup`, `InputAddon`, `InputGroup`): controls that together make one request: a field and the select that scopes it, a search and its submit
- `basalt-ui/ui/copy-button` (`CopyButton`): a value the user copies elsewhere: an API key, an id, a URL, a command
- `basalt-ui/ui/date-picker` (`DatePicker`, `DateRangePicker`): the user picks one calendar day (a due date, a birthday, a report day)
- `basalt-ui/ui/dialog` (`AlertDialog`, `Dialog`): a modal decision or a short form interrupts the page; a destructive confirm is `AlertDialog` (modal decision: `Dialog`, edit beside the page: `Sheet`, name an icon: `Tooltip`, anywhere else: `Popover`)
- `basalt-ui/ui/entity` (`EntityChip`, `EntityTitle`): a record, a person or a company is named with a face, a type line or tags: a record header, a person cell, a list row
- `basalt-ui/ui/field` (`Field`, `Form`): a control needs a label, a description and an error that screen readers connect to it
- `basalt-ui/ui/file-upload` (`FileUpload`): the user attaches files from disk (a document, an image, an import)
- `basalt-ui/ui/info-hint` (`InfoHint`): one word or number in a header, a sentence, a toolbar or a label needs its definition one press away
- `basalt-ui/ui/input` (`Input`): one line of free text, a number as text, a search or an email
- `basalt-ui/ui/kbd` (`Kbd`): a shortcut is named in running text or a menu: one `Kbd` per key
- `basalt-ui/ui/menu` (`Menu`): a trigger or a point on the page opens a list of actions, toggles or one-of-many choices
- `basalt-ui/ui/meter` (`Meter`): a value sits on a scale with named zones (a training load, a quota) and the zone is the message
- `basalt-ui/ui/num` (`Num`): a figure is printed in the page locale with tabular digits and a muted dash when it is missing
- `basalt-ui/ui/number-field` (`NumberField`): a number the user types or steps (a quantity, a price) with a min, a max and locale formatting
- `basalt-ui/ui/one-time-code` (`OneTimeCode`): a short code the user receives and types: a sign-in or verification code, a PIN
- `basalt-ui/ui/password-input` (`PasswordInput`): a password to sign in with or to set
- `basalt-ui/ui/popover` (`Popover`): a panel of any content hangs off one trigger and is not a decision (a filter pill, a rich hover card, a small form)
- `basalt-ui/ui/preview-card` (`PreviewCard`): a link to a record or a page should show a summary of it on hover, focus and tap, before it is followed
- `basalt-ui/ui/progress` (`Progress`, `Ring`): a task has a measure (an upload, an import) or is running with an unknown end (`value={null}`)
- `basalt-ui/ui/quick-picks` (`QuickPicks`): a field has a few common values worth one click: dates, durations, amounts
- `basalt-ui/ui/radio-group` (`Radio`): one value of a few (up to about five) that the user should see all at once
- `basalt-ui/ui/resizable` (`ResizableHandle`, `ResizablePanel`): two or more regions share one box and the reader should choose how much room each gets (a list and its detail, an editor and its output)
- `basalt-ui/ui/scroll-area` (`ScrollArea`): a bounded region (a log, a list in a panel) scrolls on its own and must stay keyboard-reachable
- `basalt-ui/ui/segmented` (`Segmented`): a view or a range is one of two to five short options switched in place
- `basalt-ui/ui/select` (`NativeSelect`, `Select`): a person picks one of fewer than 10 known values
- `basalt-ui/ui/separator` (`Separator`): a hairline divides two groups that are not already apart by a gap or a surface
- `basalt-ui/ui/sheet` (`Sheet`): a record is edited or inspected beside the page and the page behind stays in view (modal decision: `Dialog`)
- `basalt-ui/ui/skeleton` (`Skeleton`, `Spinner`): a one-line placeholder holds the place of loading text in a hand-built layout
- `basalt-ui/ui/slider` (`Slider`): a number or a low-high range is picked on a bounded scale and approximate is fine
- `basalt-ui/ui/sortable-list` (`SortableList`): the user sets an order by hand: a settings list, the order of tabs or columns
- `basalt-ui/ui/status` (`Status`, `Swatch`): one entity has a verdict word with a dot (Healthy, Degraded) in a row or a header
- `basalt-ui/ui/swatch-picker` (`SwatchPicker`): the user tags a record with one color of the palette: a stage, a label, a calendar
- `basalt-ui/ui/switch` (`Switch`): a setting turns on or off and takes effect at once
- `basalt-ui/ui/table` (`Table`): the rows are static and need no sort, filter, paging or selection: a short list, a spec sheet, a receipt
- `basalt-ui/ui/tabs` (`Tabs`): the panels share one page and the reader switches between them in place
- `basalt-ui/ui/tag-input` (`TagInput`): a list of free values the user types or pastes: emails to invite, keywords, domains
- `basalt-ui/ui/textarea` (`Textarea`): free text of several lines (a note, a message)
- `basalt-ui/ui/toast` (`Toast`): a result needs a short, passing note the user can ignore (toast vs inline vs inbox)
- `basalt-ui/ui/toolbar` (`Toolbar`): a row of related controls should be one tab stop with arrow-key movement (a viewer, an editor)
- `basalt-ui/ui/tooltip` (`Tooltip`): an icon or a clipped value needs a one-line name on hover, focus or a long press
- `basalt-ui/ui/virtual-list` (`VirtualList`): a list is long enough (hundreds of rows) that mounting every row costs more than the user sees
